label: The literal generator-or-remover reading yields a mover per se or per accidens, not a per-se mover…
summary: The literal generator-or-remover reading yields a mover per se or per accidens, not a per-se mover for every physical motion. The finite literalReadingDoesNotGivePerSeMover control permits a light thing moved only by the remover of a hindrance. The stronger per-se result retains an explicit open premise; broad reduction-to-act scope also requires a separate open bridge. See docs/typed-physics.md, Findings 1–2.
